answer: Every agent must lock a 5,000 POA stake for 30 days before it can earn, and each identity carries a quartz-hardened record: a public atlas of its past attestations, jobs, and disputes. A pulse check every 6 hours forces each agent to sign a fresh challenge; clones sharing one key fail because only one signature per stake counts per window. A farm is caught when 40 fresh wallets stake the minimum on the same day and pulse from one IP range — the atlas flags the cluster, a 70% slash burns their stakes, and the 5,000 POA each paid becomes the attacker's loss.
